description: Source code for the CordzHandle class in the Abseil library, managing handle queues with thread safety and diagnostics.

classes.name: CordzHandle
classes.description: Manages thread-safe handle queue with snapshot and diagnostic capabilities.

methods.name: CordzHandle
methods.description: Constructor initializing handle, optionally as a snapshot, and managing queue links.

methods.name: ~CordzHandle
methods.description: Destructor cleaning up handle from queue and deleting non-snapshot handles.

methods.name: SafeToDelete
methods.description: Checks if handle is safe to delete based on snapshot status and queue emptiness.

methods.name: Delete
methods.description: Static method to delete a handle, either immediately or by enqueueing for deletion.

methods.name: DiagnosticsGetDeleteQueue
methods.description: Returns a vector of handles in the delete queue for diagnostics.

methods.name: DiagnosticsHandleIsSafeToInspect
methods.description: Checks if a handle is safe to inspect, considering snapshot status and queue position.

methods.name: DiagnosticsGetSafeToInspectDeletedHandles
methods.description: Returns handles safe to inspect among deleted handles for diagnostics.
